description: A quarter turn of a unit circle with a signed radial gap of 9.9e-8 or -9.9e-8 to the y axis. The cap meridians share a single horn pole. Pappus gives pi*pi/2 for the volume, pi*pi for the wall area and 2*pi for the two disk caps.

analytic.counts_differ: Arris seats a circle within model tolerance of tangency on the axis, collapsing the tiny edge and its two endpoints to one shared pole. Open CASCADE keeps that edge and both vertices.

occt_step_refused.why: The Open CASCADE file keeps an ordinary edge where the torus pcurve reaches the axis within tolerance. Arris's STEP round trip has a degenerate coedge at each cap seam.
